title: App boots and renders the team sidebar
description: This verifies that the Muster UI loads, the server health endpoint answers, and the main layout (sidebar + chat area) renders without errors.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the app shell renders with a bot list or welcome/empty state visible
Verify no fatal error overlay is shown

title: Create a new agent from the sidebar
description: This verifies that the user can create a new bot and that it appears in the sidebar list.

steps.description: Find and click the new-bot / add-agent control in the sidebar
Fill in the bot name field with E2E Bot
Confirm creation
Verify a bot named E2E Bot appears in the sidebar

title: Sent message appears in the transcript immediately
description: This verifies that when the user sends a chat message to a bot, the message renders in the transcript right away — even if no engine reply arrives.

steps.description: Open the E2E Bot conversation (or any existing bot chat)
Type hello from e2e into the composer
Send the message
Verify the text hello from e2e is visible in the transcript as a sent user message

title: Second message keeps its own bubble and ordering
description: This verifies consecutive messages each render as separate entries in chronological order.

steps.description: In an open bot chat, send first e2e message
Send second e2e message
Verify both messages are visible as distinct transcript entries with second below first

title: Find bar opens inside an open chat
description: This verifies the find-in-conversation bar opens via keyboard shortcut in a bot chat.

steps.description: Open any bot chat
Press Control or Command together with F
Verify a find/search input bar appears over the chat
Close the find bar

title: Settings open and close without breaking the view
description: This verifies the settings modal opens, shows sections, and closes back to the same screen.

steps.description: Open the app settings
Verify settings content is visible with section navigation
Close settings
Verify the previous chat/sidebar view is restored

title: Team context brief persists in settings
description: This verifies the Team Context card loads existing text and accepts edits.

steps.description: Open settings and go to the General section
Type a short line into the team context textarea
Blur the textarea to save
Verify no save error indicator appears

title: Switching between bots keeps transcripts separate
description: This verifies navigating between two bots shows only each bot's own messages.

steps.description: Send a unique marker message in bot A's chat if two bots exist, otherwise create two bots first
Open bot B's chat
Verify bot A's unique marker text is not visible in bot B's transcript
Return to bot A's chat
Verify the marker message is still present in bot A's transcript

title: Invalid input does not crash the composer
description: This verifies whitespace-only or extremely long composer input is handled gracefully.

steps.description: In an open chat, type only spaces into the composer and try to send
Verify no empty message bubble appears and the app remains responsive
Clear the composer

title: No console errors during core flows
description: This verifies the browser console stays free of uncaught errors while navigating boot, chat, and settings.

steps.description: Reload the app at /
Perform a navigation across sidebar, one chat, and settings
Verify no uncaught page-level errors were reported in the console
